pgrx_sql_build_64_sql_entities.what: PgrxSql::build over 1 control file + 4 schemas + 64 ExtensionSqlEntity (graph construction and topological ordering)

pgrx_sql_to_sql_64_sql_entities.what: PgrxSql::to_sql for the same 69-entity graph (SQL generation)

environment: Linux VM (shared, ~1.5 CPU / 7.7 GB RAM), CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
notes: Baseline is the third of three runs on 2026-11-21, taken alone. Run means across the three runs: control_file_parse 3831/5014/4427 ns, pgrx_sql_build 210350/192086/190420 ns, pgrx_sql_to_sql (discarded: 13006 ns, a concurrent-run artifact contradicted by that run's own iteration count of ~253 us/iter)/258303/129827 ns. The shared VM was under load from parallel builds, so treat single reruns against the 10%/25% thresholds as noisy; pgrx_sql_to_sql also varies with HashMap iteration order between processes.
scope: Pure-Rust hot paths in pgrx-sql-entity-graph that run on every extension build. The #[pg_bench] benches in pgrx-examples/benching require a live PostgreSQL server, which this machine does not have (no pg_config, no ~/.pgrx), so they are not covered by this baseline.
